purpose: Explicit isolation of every numerical/calibration decision that RES-95 must not freeze, with its owner and qualification domain.

decisions.value: solref, solimp, margin, gap, torsional-friction and rolling-friction numeric values, penetration tolerance
decisions.sensitivity: classification and qualification domain frozen in COLLISION_CONTACT_POLICY CC-07..CC-12
decisions.notes: Provisional settings must be labeled PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL.

decisions.value: max(2 mm, contact_margin + verified numerical/penetration allowance) evaluated and sealed
torque cap, rate limit, power limit and allowed stance-phase action for the reduced net MTP moment
decisions.sensitivity: must be validated against jump/foot mechanics; saturation telemetry mandatory
decisions.notes: Must not become a hidden high-power toe motor.

decisions.value: hip/knee/ankle/trunk torque caps, torque-rate limits and activation/smoothing constants
decisions.sensitivity: elite isokinetic data are plausibility bounds only; not direct motor constants

decisions.value: E11 capture envelope, E12 robust standing envelope and post-E12 observation window
decisions.sensitivity: physical and robustness-calibrated; one-trace/ULP envelopes prohibited

decisions.value: peak landing force as a hard +20 kg elite scalar gate
decisions.sensitivity: report/validation comparator until method-matched +20 kg data exist
decisions.notes: No numeric transfer from drop-landing or unloaded studies.

decisions.value: method-matched comparator/mapping analysis before any elite hard gate

timestep refinement, solver iteration/tolerance sensitivity, contact compliance sweep, friction sweep, MTP passive sweep, midfoot alternative, placement/pose/anthropometry/initial-pose perturbations, deterministic repeatability
decisions.sensitivity: each sensitivity run records event ordering, H2, takeoff velocity, GRF, joint-limit margins, prohibited contacts, saturation, landing capture, final standing
decisions.notes: Execution of the frozen sensitivity sets is a downstream obligation; omission is a qualification defect.

decisions.value: state-causal hybrid phase machine, transition hysteresis/persistence and command continuity
decisions.sensitivity: no wall-clock-only transitions; no instantaneous torque cliffs

decisions.statement: Bar placement versus RES-83 collision shells.
decisions.value: post-implementation non-penetration confirmation in standing and all representative poses; any nominal placement change requires an authority amendment
decisions.sensitivity: report-level confirmation; nominal frozen in UB-07

decisions.value: true stance width and lateral balance authority
decisions.notes: 0.170 m remains a model geometry nominal only.
